title: Source: Intuit acquired UK-based B2B revenue management and billing startup Sequence in a sale worth ~$200M; Sequence raised $19M led by a16z in 2022 (Jess Jones/The Times)
summary: Jess Jones / The Times: Source: Intuit acquired UK-based B2B revenue management and billing startup Sequence in a sale worth ~$200M; Sequence raised $19M led by a16z in 2022 — A British financial technology business has been acquired by Intuit, the American software company, in a sale estimated to be worth around $200m …
